title: Conversation
description: A conversation with an agent, kept because somebody decided it was worth keeping. It holds what was said, what the agent ran and what it planned — not as a claim the engine can verify, but as the account of how a decision was reached.
guidance: The account of a conversation somebody chose to keep. It records how a decision was reached and is not itself a claim about the project: do not treat its contents as verified, and write anything it settled as a record of the type that settles it.
